articles.headline: Aerospike, AMD and Google Gemini push real-time agentic fraud detection
articles.summary: Aerospike is combining its database, Google Gemini, the Agent Development Kit, and AMD EPYC-powered Cloud C4D VMs to support real-time fraud detection at machine speed. For businesses, this matters because faster detection can reduce payment fraud losses and improve response times in financial and commerce workflows.

articles.headline: Swift launches blockchain-based shared ledger with major banks
articles.summary: Swift launched a blockchain-based shared ledger with an initial set of 16 banks, including Citi and HSBC, to enable round-the-clock payments and compete with stablecoins. This could matter for businesses that rely on cross-border payments because it may eventually change settlement speed, liquidity management, and transaction costs.

articles.headline: CISA says it had to build its incident playbook during a live cybersecurity event
articles.summary: TechCrunch reports that the U.S. cybersecurity agency CISA had to develop parts of its incident response playbook while the incident was still unfolding. For businesses, the key implication is that public-sector cyber readiness remains uneven, reinforcing the need for stronger internal response plans and vendor controls.
